detected_fault: Flickering screen issue while playing games
suggested_solution: Monitor Temperature: Ensure that the laptop is not overheating.
Driver Updates: Install the latest drivers for the graphics card and other hardware components.
BIOS Updates: Check for any BIOS updates on the Asus website and install them if necessary.
Display Calibration: Run a display calibration tool, such as DisplayCal or ColorCal, to ensure that the display is properly calibrated and not experiencing any issues.
